ForumIAS is organizing a special session under the MGP Strategy Series with A.R. Rajah Mohaideen (AIR 7, UPSC CSE 2025) , who secured an exceptional 138 marks in GS Paper 4 (Ethics) . The session will be organised in Online mode only. We will share the e-meet link with all students immediately after registration.

The objective of this session is not merely to discuss Ethics content but to understand the approach, preparation strategy, and answer-writing framework that helped him secure one of the highest scores in the paper.
